# Wintun redistributable

This directory vendors the **official** Wintun 0.14.1 signed DLLs from
https://www.wintun.net/ (SHA2-256 of zip:
`07c256185d6ee3652e09fa55c0b673e2624b565e02c4b9091c79ca7d2f24ef51`).

- `amd64/wintun.dll` — installed beside `Nyxveil.Service.exe`
- `arm64/wintun.dll` — available for arm64 builds
- `LICENSE.txt` — prebuilt binary license from the official ZIP (required notice)

Do **not** replace these DLLs with unofficial builds. See WINTUN.md.
